evidence.source_workspace: Phase 1 and repair_001 entry local workspace; source hashes below identify pre-repair files.
evidence.source_line_references: Line numbers in this identity refer to the pre-repair sources identified here, not subsequently inserted repair lines.
evidence.evidence_note: Values were read from preserved Phase 1 artifacts and checked against source; no new propagation was used to create this record.

passive_fiber.derivation_MFD_provenance: Executable loader default for lambda0 < 1300 nm; source comment attributes it to Thorlabs 1060XP at 1030 nm. External device provenance has not been revalidated.
resolution_order: run_mamyshev.m:63-70 sets lambda0=1035 nm/f0 and calls load_default_GMMNLSE_propagate([],sim8,'single_mode').
load_default_GMMNLSE_propagate.m:402-410 resolves lambda0 from f0 first; :425-427 chooses default MFD=5.95 um.
load_default_GMMNLSE_propagate.m:432-449 derives Aeff, SR and gain_Aeff; :610-613 returns the defaults for empty input_fiber.
run_mamyshev.m:71 then assigns fiber8.MFD=10.5 without recomputing SR or gain_Aeff.
run_mamyshev.m:83-92 copies fiber8 into the three passive cavity segments; :280-287 copies it into the output pigtail.

diagnostic_counterfactual_only.note: This ratio diagnoses inconsistent derived fields. It is not a correction factor for pulse width, energy or power.

gain_fiber.resolution_order: run_mamyshev.m:78-80 passes MFD=11.1 into the loader before SR and gain_Aeff are derived.

preserved_physical_rules.passive_length_rule: Fixed legacy lengths; no implicit scaling with gain length.
preserved_physical_rules.N_total_resolution: run_mamyshev.m:137-140 discards the concentration output from gain_info and explicitly uses 9e7.

cross_section_source.note: No cross-section arrays are copied into this public record.

preserved_physical_rules.repetition_period_rule: Initial sum(segment lengths)/(1/beta1*1e12); original update adds accumulated time_delay*1e-12 to the initial period.

filter_rule.note: Preserved as implemented; no claim that this is a lossless complementary port or that nominal bandwidth equals measured intensity FWHM for gaussexpo=4.

compressor.note: Original physical assumptions retained. Compressor optimization/metric definitions belong to the separately recorded numerical/result protocol.

rng.note: run_mamyshev does not internally fix the seed. This is the preserved Phase 1 initial random state, not a new production default.

validation_limits: The declared 10.5 um value is not established here as the actual device MFD.
